github.problem_summary: gsl_starter_1_3 template requires an input image (car and landscape) that is not bundled with the template and has no note on where to obtain it, so the workflow is incomplete for every fresh user.

github.solution: Commenter smithian123 (2026-05-19): un-bypassing the ImageScaleToTotalPixels node fixed the grey output. Affects anyone who runs the template as shipped since the node ships bypassed.
github.problem_summary: image_hidream_o1_dev template produces a grey image (or pure noise for others, incl. fp8/mxfp8 variants; edit mode broken) even with default prompts and correct model placement. Root cause: the ImageScaleToTotalPixels node in the template is bypassed, corrupting the image path.

github.solution: OP (C1): 'The ComfyUI version was too old, but it's running fine after the update.' m8rr (C0) had pointed to the GGUF node. Upgrading ComfyUI resolves it.
github.problem_summary: CLIPTextEncode fails with ValueError 'not enough values to unpack (expected 4, got 1)' (GGUF text-encoder path) on an outdated ComfyUI install.

github.solution: OP (C2/C3): fixed by downgrading - the portable ComfyUI 0.30.0 build generates normal audio. (Regression in newer versions; no upstream fix identified.)
github.problem_summary: H3 generated-video audio always has static/popping on RTX 4080 Super across ComfyUI 0.31/0.33 regardless of sampler, LoRA, precision, or attention choice.

github.solution: Maintainer rattus128 (C3): the MiniMax VAE has built-in tiling (trained tile size, <8GB VRAM) - use the standard VAE Decode node, the tiled node is incompatible. LIQUIDMIND111 (C4) confirms standard decode works.
github.problem_summary: VAEDecodeTiled on MiniMax H3 video fails with 'to() received an invalid combination of arguments - got (NestedTensor)'.

github.solution: OP (C5): updating to torch 2.11.0+cu128 fixed it on Windows. cushycrux (C6) fixed the triton compile variant via woct0rdho/triton-windows #8 (embedded-python notes). hum-ma (C8): don't use the tiled node - H3 VAE has built-in tiling (see #15274).
github.problem_summary: H3 audio/video VAE decode crashes (NestedTensor error in decode_tiled) on torch 2.9.1+cu128 (WSL and Windows); related triton 'Python.h not found' compile errors also seen.

github.solution: OP-confirmed (issue body): switch back to sdpa attention for wan2.2 video; flicker fully disappears. No maintainer reply, so treat as known trade-off of SageAttention quantization.
github.problem_summary: SageAttention (3.1.0) on Wan 2.2 video generation causes temporal flickering/flashing that disappears when switching back to default sdpa attention with all other parameters unchanged — quantized attention compromises temporal layers.

github.solution: OP diagnosed and maintainer kijai (2026-04-02) confirmed: open the mask editor and save (even unchanged) to replace the 64x64 placeholder; maintainer promised a guard. Rounding stays floor-by-design — maintainer reluctant to change existing workflows' behavior.
github.problem_summary: Two issues: (1) rounding 32 floors 1080→1056 instead of rounding up; (2) IndexError when crop is enabled with a mask attached — caused by Load Image passing a 64x64 placeholder mask when none was drawn/edited.

github.solution: Maintainer (rluxemburg) states definitive cause: 'This is a checkpoint/code version mismatch. Please check whether you downloaded LTX-2 or LTX-2.3 model weights' — match weight version to the node pack.
github.problem_summary: Loading state_dict for LTXAVModel fails with scale_shift_table size mismatches (5,2048 vs 8,2048 etc.) after downloading models from HuggingFace — checkpoint version vs node-pack/model-code version mismatch.

github.solution: OP confirmed root cause was resolution: 800x456 is not divisible by 16 (456/16=28.5), causing the audio cross-attention reshape mismatch; switching to 832x480 in ImageScaleByAspectRatio fixed it completely (OP comment 'rookie-thomas'). Corroborated by Booyaka101's clean repro on current main and maintainer (kijai) saying the example workflow runs unchanged.
github.problem_summary: InfiniteTalk/MultiTalk crashes at multitalk.py:247 reshape (tensor size mismatch) after updating to ComfyUI 0.19.x; suspected off-by-one frame count. Anyone running 800x456 (non-16-divisible resolution) hits it.

github.solution: OP self-confirmed workarounds with logs: run ComfyUI with --disable-pinned-memory and replace the WanVideo BlockSwap node with the older 'WanVideo Enhanced BlockSwap' node — this stopped RAM growth and enabled 1920x1024x61-frame generation on a 5060 Ti 16GB. For sageattn_3: use the per_block_mean sageattn3 mode (or keep SageAttention 2.2 for first/last steps); torch.compile reduce-overhead is blocked by Windows cudaMallocAsync pool limits (not fixable via --disable-cuda-malloc).
github.problem_summary: WanVideo BlockSwap causes unbounded system-RAM growth on Windows (96GB filled by ~3rd run, pinned-memory related), and sageattn_3 + torch.compile either OOMs, degrades quality, or reduce-overhead fails (cudaMallocAsync pool conflict on Windows). Self-resolved with detailed evidence, 0 comments.

github.solution: Maintainer kijai (2026-06-13): output looks like wrong model or missing distill lora; uninstall xformers, use standard pytorch attention or SageAttention. OP confirmed quality returned after removing xformers, cleaning caches and re-attaching the LoRAs.
github.problem_summary: LTX-2.3 videos degraded to muddy, structureless output after dependency churn; intermittent 'ghost' recovery. Root cause: running without the required distill LoRA and with xformers installed (should not be used with these nodes).

github.solution: molbal's fork (github.com/molbal/ComfyUI-GGUF) loads MiniMax-H3 GGUFs incl. Unsloth quants — OP alish119 confirmed it 'works excellently' after fixing his own error (pixel count must be a multiple of 32) and using the 'Unet Loader (Dynamic VRAM)' node inside the comfy.org subgraph workflow (molbal comment + OP confirmation).
github.problem_summary: MiniMax-H3 GGUF (UNet + qwen3vl text encoder) unsupported by mainline nodes; users need a working loader/TE combination and correct workflow settings.

github.solution: Fixed by PR #15648. 0xDELUXA (C0/C1) diagnosed the missing-AOTriton-kernel root cause and suggested --use-split-cross-attention as a test; OP (C2) confirms 'It is solved after merging #15648' and C5 confirms the merge.
github.problem_summary: RX 9060 XT crashes with 'CUDA error: invalid argument' running the official MiniMax H3 t2v workflow (AOTriton/SDPA kernel path).

github.solution: Workaround confirmed by OP (C5) and others: swap the node for 'Patch Sage Attention KJ' (aakash-chaddha, C2) - after which the native H3 patch also started working again for some. Real fix tracked in PR #15270 (still open at thread end).
github.problem_summary: MiniMaxH3MemoryEfficientSageAttentionPatch fails with 'sageattention is not new enough version or could not determine CUDA architecture' despite correct torch 2.13+cu130 / sageattention 2.2.0 - node's own version/arch check bug.

github.solution: OP (C2) and partridge (C5): rolling back to 0.30.0 restores 12-min runtimes. comfyanonymous (C9) suggested renaming custom_nodes to rule them out - partially helped one user then reverted. Root regression in 0.31 memory management left unfixed.
github.problem_summary: Official MiniMax H3 workflow doubles in runtime (12 -> 25+ min) after the 0.31 update on 5080/5090/H200/5060Ti; VRAM underused, disk thrashing each gen.

github.solution: OP guayar (C1) root-caused it and --disable-mmap 'completely fixed' load times; independently confirmed by zenmasterzardoz (C2, gfx1100) and boxwrench (C4, 0.33.2). Underlying per-tensor mmap-transfer defect still needs a core fix honoring disable_mmap everywhere.
github.problem_summary: On ROCm, model loading became ~15x slower: per-tensor ~0.5s fixed overhead when .to(device) copies mmap-backed safetensors tensors (cost scales with tensor count).

github.solution: OP-confirmed fixes: --disable-pinned-memory (title/body), and eoris' CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 / --cuda-device <uuid> to hide the second GPU (C6, and akashzeno C9's controlled A/B). rattus128 worked a speculative fix in PR #14252; aimdo 0.4.5+ 'cold marking of pins' also shipped.
github.problem_summary: After the pinned-memory update, WAN 2.2 (and later MiniMax H3) intermittently fails at 'HostBuffer.read_file_slice failed'/CUDA OOM during weight loading, mostly on multi-GPU systems.

github.solution: Booyaka101 root-caused it: comfy-aimdo is still dlopen'd (RTLD_GLOBAL) on WSL by main.py line 45 even with dynamic VRAM disabled. OP (C1/C12) confirms --disable-dynamic-vram fixes it and that commenting out the dlopen confirms the diagnosis; fix proposed in PR #13818 (WSL guard), not yet merged at thread end.
github.problem_summary: Custom LoRA-trainer (block swapping) OOMs at pinned-memory allocation on >=0.16 in WSL/5090 although RAM/VRAM are free; worked 21h on 0.9.x.

github.solution: Maintainer kijai (2026-09-06): 'Should be fixed now' via recent PR; also notes the low-VRAM attention is no longer needed with comfy core sparse attention. OP confirmed (2026-09-08) the H3 Low VRAM attention breakage is fixed. Side-thread: VRAM/OOM with Model Preview Override traced to comfy-compiler/aimdo, mitigated by --disable-comfy-compiler.
github.problem_summary: MiniMax H3 Low/VRAM attention node fails with minimax_block_lowmem_forward() got an unexpected keyword argument 'attention' after upstream model API changes.

github.solution: Community fix (posted by OP Magenta-6 from Gemini diagnosis, referencing #494): remove `pad` from the kornia import block in pyramid_blending.py and add `from torch.nn.functional import pad`. OP confirmed 'THIS FIXED THE PROBLEM', and two later commenters confirm; caveat: re-appears after node updates until PR merges.
github.problem_summary: LTX IC Lora Loader (Model Only) shows as unknown/missing because the whole ComfyUI-LTXVideo pack fails to import: kornia 0.8.x no longer re-exports `pad` from kornia.geometry.transform.pyramid, killing pyramid_blending.py at import time.

github.solution: Danny-707 links the #538 fix (remove/reinstall or git pull the node pack) and peterducan-hub confirms it worked; OP separately confirmed a clean 'ComfyUI easy install' fixed it.
github.problem_summary: Several LTX nodes error after install — pack import failure after a ComfyUI update (same class as #538 interleaved_freqs_cis break), so nodes fail to register.

github.solution: Commenter lin-bot23 says Z-Image-Turbo expects CFG=1 and takes no negative prompt - distortion comes from high CFG, not the node; use the Z-Image template if negative prompting is needed (https://github.com/Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image). OP (FrizzSoft) disputed, arguing empty CLIP Text Encode behaves better at CFG~1.5. No maintainer ruling or template change confirmed.
github.problem_summary: Z-Image-Turbo Text to Image template wires ConditioningZeroOut into the negative KSampler input; at CFG above 1 this produces distorted output, while an empty CLIP Text Encode node gives cleaner results.

github.solution: Reporter (from comfy_cloud MCP smoke test) provided full diagnosis and two concrete fixes: republish the template against the current GeminiNanoBanana2 node schema (prompt, model, seed, aspect_ratio, resolution, response_modalities, thinking_level) or reinstate GeminiNanoBanana2V2 on cloud. No maintainer response; nothing confirmed fixed.
github.problem_summary: templates/api_google_nano_banana2_image_edit.json references node type GeminiNanoBanana2V2 which no longer exists on Comfy Cloud (only GeminiNanoBanana2), failing validation for everyone ('unknown node type(s)'), and its widgets_values are in the old V2 order so a mere rename still fails value_not_in_list checks.

github.solution: Maintainer (comfyui-wiki) said 'Please update your comfyui first' — the missing nodes are core nodes added in ComfyUI 0.11.1. OP never confirmed; dhosein remains stuck because their Desktop install reports no update available.
github.problem_summary: audio_ace_step_1_5_checkpoint template loads with missing core nodes (EmptyAceStep1.5LatentAudio, TextEncodeAceStepAudio1.5 — shipped with ComfyUI 0.11.1); ACE custom nodes also crash get_object_info because ACE-Step model dirs don't exist. A second user hit the same on every ACE 1.5 template with a Desktop build reporting no updates available.

github.solution: Maintainer (comfyui-wiki) posted a workaround video: use the flux.2 dev fp8 template instead and unpack the subgraph — the multi-image inputs are there. No OP confirmation.
github.problem_summary: The flux2.dev template's subgraph conversion dropped/hid the multi-image input the older workflow had; maintainer admits 'maybe we do a bad conversion for this template'.

github.solution: Fix per affected users (not OP/maintainer): fully update the ComfyUI backend+frontend — diverHansun confirmed updating to latest solved it, seanntxj fixed it by force-updating via command line instead of ComfyUI-Manager (one user still broken on 0.3.76 after Manager update). diverHansun links the official comfyui-wiki update guide.
github.problem_summary: Freshly-installed template fails at CLIPLoader: 'size mismatch for Llama2 state_dict' (Qwen3-shaped 2560-hidden weights loaded into a Llama arch) — hits a wave of users on older ComfyUI builds that can't load the new text-encoder weights.

github.solution: Maintainer (comfyui-wiki): 'This model support requires custom nodes. Please follow the note in the guide to install the custom nodes.' Users report the Manager finds no such nodes (same family as #422), so no confirmed install path.
github.problem_summary: video_wan2_2_14B_animate template opens with 2 missing nodes ('Cannot execute because a node is missing the class_type property'); ComfyUI-Manager shows nothing to install and restarts don't help. A second user (Watermelon6093) reports the same.

github.solution: LukeG89 (C0): install missing dep into python_embeded (`python_embeded\python.exe -m pip install SQLAlchemy`); OP confirmed import then works (v2.0.52). bhusann (C3): for manager also `pip install -r manager_requirements.txt` or clone ComfyUI-Manager into custom_nodes.
github.problem_summary: ModuleNotFoundError: sqlalchemy when launching with --enable-manager on Windows portable; dependencies not installed in embedded python.

github.solution: anr2me (C0): CUDA and ROCm torch can't coexist; need a separate venv with ROCm torch for the AMD GPU. Kosinkadink (maintainer, C1): the 'Advanced' section of the install window lets you pick the environment/backend version.
github.problem_summary: Desktop autodetects only the Nvidia GPU on a mixed Nvidia+AMD system - one PyTorch build (CUDA vs ROCm) can't see both vendors.

github.solution: Maintainer rattus128 (C3): behavior across installs/OSes points to failing hardware. OP (C6) confirms: OCCT VRAM test 'spitting out errors like crazy' - faulty GPU VRAM, replacing under warranty; --novram works around until then.
github.problem_summary: Intermittent black/grey outputs and NaN latents across SDXL/Wan/Flux2 on a 5080, persisting across OSes and clean installs.

github.solution: Maintainer kijai (2026-05-21): 'Update ComfyUI itself.' Commenter confirmed updating the ComfyUI core fixed it.
github.problem_summary: KJNodes 'Load VAE' (audio VAE loader) throws RuntimeError: VAE is invalid: None with ltx_2.0_vae.safetensors when ComfyUI core is outdated.

github.solution: OP aswordok (2026-03-13): updating ComfyUI-KJNodes to the nightly via Manager fixed it (latest release was too old at the time); commenter ccran adds updating ComfyUI to latest also fixes it.
github.problem_summary: SimpleCalculatorKJ throws TypeError on 'variables.a' kwarg and VAE load fails — stale KJNodes/ComfyUI versions incompatible with the workflow.
